Hi Sarah — Professor Alvarez. I'm setting up next week's CSE455 staff meeting (week of Nov 23–27).

My own free time that week is tight — the only clear gaps are:
- Mon 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30

Could you tell me when you're free that week? If one of the slots above works on your side, say which and I'll book it (30 minutes). If none does, send me your free gaps and I'll find something that fits us both — it has to sit in free time for both of us.

Hello — Professor Alvarez (CSE455). I'm arranging next week's CSE455 staff meeting and want to make sure I'm not booking over anything official.

Two questions:
1. Is there anything already scheduled on the official calendar next week (Nov 23–27) that concerns CSE455 or its staff?
2. Which times next week are free for a CSE455 staff meeting?

I'll book it in free time once I hear back, and log it on my calendar.

Hi Professor Alvarez — glad to. Next week (Nov 23–27) my free time is exactly:

- Tue 24th, 15:00–15:30
- Wed 25th, 10:00–10:30
- Wed 25th, 13:00–13:30

Monday, Thursday and Friday are booked end to end for me, so nothing there works.

All three of your gaps in that list fit on my side: Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30. Any of them suits me for the CSE455 staff meeting — pick whichever fits the others best and I'll put it on my calendar (30 min, staff meeting with you). Those three windows are also the whole of my free time that week, so if none of them works for the group, tell me and I'll see what I can do.
Thanks — noted. I'm checking with the department office for anything official in those windows, and I'll confirm the slot as soon as they come back. Tue 15:00–15:30 is my first pick.

A short follow-up to my earlier note: the candidate windows for the CSE455 staff meeting next week (Nov 23–27) are Tue 24th 15:00–15:30, Wed 25th 10:00–10:30 and Wed 25th 13:00–13:30. If any of those collides with an official event, tell me which and I'll drop it; otherwise say which one is clear.

Good — Tue 15:00–15:30 noted as your first pick. I'll leave that window open and put the CSE455 staff meeting on my calendar (Tue 15:00–15:30 with you, 30 min) as soon as you confirm it. Happy to hear what the office says first.

Hello Professor Alvarez. Next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) the official schedule stands: nothing on it has been cancelled or moved.

**1. What concerns CSE455 and its staff next week**
- Mon 14:30–15:20 CSE455 lecture; Mon 16:30–17:00 CSE455 office hours
- Tue 09:00–10:30 CSE455 lecture; Tue 12:20–13:30 CSE455 office hours; Tue 15:30–16:20 CSE455 office hours; Tue 16:20–17:00 CSE455 quiz section
- Wed 10:30–12:00 CSE455 office hours; Wed 13:30–14:20 CSE455 quiz section
- Fri 13:20–14:30 CSE455 lecture; Fri 15:20–17:00 CSE455 office hours

Besides those, your own teaching and governance duties are on the calendar as well (curriculum committee, colloquium, faculty meetings, thesis committee, guest lecture prep, department seminars).

**2. Free time next week** (working hours 09:00–17:00, avoiding all official events)
- Mon 10:00–13:00
- Tue 11:10–12:10, 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30, 12:00–13:30, 16:00–17:00
- Thu 11:10–13:40, 14:40–15:30
- Fri 10:00–12:30

A staff meeting with your TAs goes into free time, so any of those windows works. I keep the official schedule only: I do not know anyone's private appointments and cannot confirm the TAs' availability — the meeting is booked once every participant has it on their calendar, and the change should be logged on yours.

All three are clear of official events:

- **Tue 24th 15:00–15:30** — clear (CSE452 lecture ends 15:00, CSE455 office hours start 15:30)
- **Wed 25th 10:00–10:30** — clear (CSE452 lecture and thesis committee end 10:00, CSE455 office hours start 10:30)
- **Wed 25th 13:00–13:30** — clear (CSE455 quiz section starts 13:30)

Any of them fits free time. I keep the official schedule only, so I can't speak for the TAs' own appointments — the meeting is booked once every participant has it on their calendar, and the change should be logged on yours.
Hello Sarah — the department office here. You've reached my web chat; write me any time about the official schedule, courses and rooms. Anything I can help with?

Confirmed: CSE455 staff meeting, Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30 with you. The office says that window is clear of official events, so please put it on your calendar — that makes it booked. Mine is booked too.

Hello — Sarah here, TA for CSE455. Nothing urgent: I'm settling my calendar for next week (Nov 23–27). If anything official lands in that week that concerns CSE455 or my own teaching duties — sections, office hours, staff meetings, department meetings — I'd be glad to have it in writing so I can keep my commitments straight. I'm currently holding Tue 25th, 15:00–15:30 open for the CSE455 staff meeting, pending confirmation. Anything else that week I should know about?

Done — CSE455 staff meeting, Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 with you, is on my calendar and logged. Since yours is booked too, that's the meeting settled. Thanks for checking with the office. See you Tuesday.
Thank you — booking CSE455 staff meeting Tue 24th 15:00–15:30, logged on my calendar. Nothing further needed.

Hello Sarah. Nothing official next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) is cancelled or moved; everything stands as scheduled. The CSE455 items are:

- Mon 23rd 14:30–15:20 CSE455 lecture; 16:30–17:00 CSE455 office hours
- Tue 24th 09:00–10:30 CSE455 lecture; 12:20–13:30 CSE455 office hours; 15:30–16:20 CSE455 office hours; 16:20–17:00 CSE455 quiz section
- Wed 25th 10:30–12:00 CSE455 office hours; 13:30–14:20 CSE455 quiz section
- Fri 27th 13:20–14:30 CSE455 lecture; 15:20–17:00 CSE455 office hours

Your quiz sections and office hours above are the CSE455 duties on the official calendar; there is no department meeting for TAs that week.

Tue 24th 15:00–15:30 is clear of official events, so it can hold the staff meeting. I keep the official schedule only: a staff meeting is booked once every participant has it on their calendar, and the change should be logged on yours.

Thank you — that's logged, and the staff meeting Tue 24th 15:00–15:30 is on my calendar now (BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with Alvarez). Confirmed with Professor Alvarez too, so all participants have it.

One thing I want to get right before I touch anything: comparing your list with my calendar, my own CSE455 duties there are

- Tue 24th 15:30–16:20 office hours — I have it
- Tue 24th 16:20–17:00 quiz section — I have it
- Wed 25th 10:30–12:00 office hours — I have it
- Wed 25th 13:30–14:20 quiz section — I have it

but Mon 23rd 16:30–17:00 CSE455 office hours and Tue 24th 12:20–13:30 CSE455 office hours are not on my calendar, and both sit inside entries of mine (Mon 15:40–17:00 CSE444 lecture, Tue 12:10–13:40 CSE444 lecture). Are those two office hours mine, or another TA's? If they're mine, tell me and I'll sort out the clash with the CSE444 lectures rather than just overwrite them.

Those two are not yours: the official schedule lists Mon 23rd 16:30–17:00 CSE455 office hours and Tue 24th 12:20–13:30 CSE455 office hours under **Professor Alvarez**. Your CSE455 duties are the four you already have (Tue 15:30–16:20 office hours, Tue 16:20–17:00 quiz section, Wed 10:30–12:00 office hours, Wed 13:30–14:20 quiz section).

On the overlap with the CSE444 lectures: those lectures are official events and stand as scheduled — the office does not move or cancel them, and nothing is dropped for a clash. Please don't overwrite an official entry; if your calendar shows a conflict, keep both entries and take it up with the lecturer concerned rather than deleting either.

Understood, thank you — I've left my calendar exactly as it is, and I raised the two entries with you rather than overwriting anything. My CSE455 duties are the four you list, all present. Noted on the CSE444 lectures: official events stand, and if a clash shows up I'll keep both entries and speak to the lecturer. My log has one line for this week: BOOKED Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with Alvarez.
